models.title: Deferred tax liability from an asset taxable temporary difference
models.summary: The reading multiplies an asset taxable temporary difference by the applicable tax rate.

relationship.original_equation: Deferred tax liability = (asset carrying amount - tax base) × applicable tax rate
relationship.translation_notes: This is an undiscounted liability from one asset; the positive taxable difference is carrying amount less tax base. The accessible Australian standard is cited as corroboration of the matching rule; jurisdiction-specific differences require review.

assumptions: The temporary difference is taxable on recovery and recognized under the applicable standard; no recognition exception applies.

models.title: Deferred tax asset from an asset deductible temporary difference
models.summary: An asset tax base above its carrying amount gives a deductible temporary difference subject to recognition conditions.

relationship.original_equation: Deferred tax asset = (asset tax base - carrying amount) × applicable tax rate
relationship.translation_notes: This is an undiscounted asset from one deductible difference; tax base minus carrying amount is nonnegative under the guard. The accessible Australian standard is cited as corroboration of the matching rule; jurisdiction-specific differences require review.

assumptions: Recognition criteria are met and the full deductible temporary difference can be utilized.
One applicable enacted or substantively enacted reversal-period tax rate applies.
limitations: Recognition is limited by expected taxable profit and any applicable exceptions; valuation allowances or partial recognition are outside this simple profile.
Tax law and rate depend on jurisdiction, timing and recovery method.
